text:
emma: Quick sync — finalizing newsletter + webinar invite for the launch next Tue. Need subject lines, segmentation, and send cadence. Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-webinar-draft. TL;DR: demo + benchmark narratives + CTA to start a trial. Who can review subject variants by EOD?

raj: On it. I'll own segmentation and send windows. Plan to split: trial users (high intent), active API companies, and cold leads. Will propose cadence after I size lists.

sofia: Can we A/B test subject lines? thinking: 'See Redwood inference at 30ms' vs 'How we cut inference costs 3x'. Also want a softer brand variant: 'Live: Redwood launch + demo'.

liam: Agree on A/B. Also recommend 2 send windows for APAC/EU to avoid odd hours. Draft subject + preheader sample below:

```
Subject A: See Redwood inference at 30ms — live demo
Preheader: Watch a short benchmark and get access to early credits.

Subject B: How we cut inference costs 3x for production apps
Preheader: Real numbers, live demo, and a free trial.
```

maya: Sizing note: expected recipients ~12k across segments. Deliverability: I recommend a 20% overnight throttle + 80% day-of for the big segment, and a smaller 10% test send Monday AM. I can queue that if you confirm.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketing send quota for Tue 09:00 UTC is 15k. Use send-group 'launch-webinar'.

emma: Good call @maya @liam. @raj please add schedule & segment filters to the doc. Also we need the webinar landing page A/B variants ready — link: https://redwood.app/launch-webinar (draft).

sofia: I'll add three subject variants into the doc now:
1) "Live: How Redwood made inference predictable"
2) "Benchmark: 2x throughput at half the cost"
3) "Join our launch webinar + live demo"
Will mark a preferred combo for trial users.

raj: Segmentation rules (draft):
- trial_users: user_last_active <= 14 days AND api_calls_last_14d >= 3 AND unsubscribed = false
- power_accounts: company_seats >= 10 AND account_status = active
- cold_leads: marketing_list = newsletter AND last_engagement > 90 days
- exclude: bounced, suppressed lists, unsubscribed

I'll paste the exact SQL filters in the doc in a bit.

liam: Quick email snippet for the landing link — please copy/edit: 

```
Subject: {{subject}}
Preheader: Quick demo of the new runtime + benchmark results
Hi {{first_name}},
We’re hosting a short webinar to show the new Redwood inference runtime and real benchmark results. Join us for a live demo and Q&A.
Register: https://redwood.app/launch-webinar
Cheers,
The Redwood Team
```

maya: Drip plan suggestion: reminder 3 days before, 1 day before, and 1 hour before. Post-event: recording + short survey + CTA to try (send 24h after). For registrants who don't attend: follow-up with recording + 'try now' link.

emma: Perfect. Action items: @sofia sign off final subject by 3pm PT; @raj paste final segment filters + send groups; @maya schedule the test send Mon 09:30 PT and the main rollout Tue 09:00 UTC; I'll upload the final copy to the doc and schedule the dry run.

sofia: Will do — aiming to mark A as preferred by 2:30pm PT.

raj: I'll have the filters and expected list counts up in the doc within the hour.

maya: Scheduling the test send now. I’ll post the send preview screenshots in the doc once ready.

emma: Thanks team :rocket: keep thread updated if any timing changes.

liam: Ack :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled test send for group 'launch-test' on Mon 09:30 PT.

sofia: Done — final note: please avoid super-salesy language in the subject for trial users. Keep the benchmark angle.

emma: Noted. We'll keep messaging segmented. Thanks all.
